verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since accounting software could plausibly ship AI or agent-driven anomaly and duplicate detection. The evidence pack shows no agent, no anomaly or spend-flagging feature, and no documented API, MCP, or webhook surface an external agent could use; the developer portal was unreachable and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404. Pro-plan bank-feed 'auto-merge' and the trend reports are passive bookkeeping conveniences, not agent monitoring or flagging, so they do not deliver this story.
